products.name: The Imperial Vanilla & Macaron Crown

products.name: Sicilian Pistachio & Raspberry Chantilly

products.name: Atelier Bespoke Custom Celebration Tier

reviews.comment: Ordered this for my daughter 21st celebration. The sugar crown was an absolute showstopper and the bourbon vanilla sponge was the lightest texture I have ever tasted in London or Paris.
Uncompromising chocolate mastery. The mirror glaze was flawless and the hazelnut feuilletine provided the most satisfying contrast. Delivered punctual to the minute.
Semurug created our dream wedding centerpiece. All 90 guests raved about the passionfruit curd and champagne sponge. Professional tasting and flawless white-glove setup.
Bright, refreshing, and gorgeous on the table. The passionfruit drizzle elevates this far beyond standard bakery fruit cakes. Will be reordering for every summer dinner.

faqs.question: Tort buyurtmasini qancha vaqt oldin berish tavsiya etiladi?
faqs.answer: Katalogimizdagi mualliflik tortlari uchun qandolatchilarimiz biskvitni pishirishi, to'yintirishi va kremlarni yetiltirishi uchun kamida 12–24 soat oldin buyurtma berish tavsiya etiladi. Ko'p qavatli to'y tortlari va murakkab shaxsiy kompozitsiyalar uchun sanani 2-4 hafta oldin bron qilish maqsadga muvofiqdir.

faqs.question: Yetkazib berish paytida tort qanday himoyalanadi?
faqs.answer: Barcha Semurug tortlari maxsus ikki qavatli termo-izolyatsiyalangan qutilarda va harorat nazorati ostidagi maxsus sovutgichli avtomobillarda yetkaziladi. Kuryerlarimiz shakar gullari, ko'zgu jiloli ganash va nozik bezaklar bus-butun yetib borishini ta'minlaydi.

faqs.question: Parhez yoki allergiyaga mos (glyutensiz, yong'oqsiz) tortlar bormi?
faqs.answer: Ha, talabingizga binoan glyutensiz un ishlatilmagan shokoladli tortlar va sut mahsulotlarisiz variantlarni tayyorlab beramiz. Ammo barcha mahsulotlarimiz yong'oq, bodom va qaymoq ishlatiladigan professional ustaxonada tayyorlanishini inobatga oling.

faqs.question: To'y arafasidagi juftliklar uchun shaxsiy degustatsiya mavjudmi?
faqs.answer: Albatta. Bizning markazimizda bosh qandolatchimiz ishtirokida 4 xil biskvit, mevali konfiturlar va nozik kremlarni tatib ko'rish uchun maxsus degustatsiya tashkil etiladi.

faqs.question: Buyurtma sanasini o'zgartirish yoki bekor qilish tartibi qanday?
faqs.answer: Buyurtma sanasini yetkazib berishdan 48 soat oldin bepul o'zgartirishingiz mumkin. Murakkab qo'l mehnati talab qiladigan maxsus buyurtmalar uchun kamida 5 kun oldin xabar berish so'raladi.
